sections.headline: Great ideas
sections.body: And they should go places. Into rooms. Across screens. Onto stages. Into the hands and heads of real people. We bring events and creative work together to make sure they do.

items.title: An idea is a start.
items.description: We take the good part of “what if?” and turn it into something you can actually experience. From the first sketch to the final detail, we connect the ideas, people and production that bring it to life.

sections.headline: Too good to leave
sections.body:
You know that feeling when an idea clicks and suddenly you can see the whole thing? We live for that part. But we love what happens next even more.

The planning. The pixels. The people. The power cables. The tiny decisions nobody notices until they are done right. We connect creative thinking with the practical craft it takes to bring a concept into the world. So the work does more than look impressive. It feels right, behaves right and makes people want to be part of it.

items.title: First, we
items.description: We start by getting curious. About the people in the room, the story worth telling and the thing this idea really needs to do. We ask awkwardly good questions, challenge the obvious and connect unlikely dots until we find a direction everyone can believe in.

items.title: Then, we
items.description: Then we get our hands into it. The sketches become identities, layouts, websites, run sheets and real-world production plans. Creative thinking meets the people who build things, and we sweat the tiny details so the big picture feels effortless.

items.title: Finally, we
items.description: Then comes the part you can feel. The doors open, the site goes live, the lights come up and people step into the idea. All the planning disappears into the experience, leaving the atmosphere, the connection and the moments people talk about afterwards.

sections.headline: From a spark
sections.body:
The room. The crowd. The goosebumps. The perfectly timed reveal.

We dream up, design and deliver events that people remember. From corporate conferences and brand launches to festivals, activations and private celebrations, we bring the creative thinking, people and production together to make every moment count.

sections.headline: The guest list is only the beginning.
sections.body:
An event starts long before anyone walks through the door. It starts with a question. What do we want people to feel, experience and remember?

That's where we come in. We take an idea and build an entire experience around it. The concept, the space, the atmosphere, the people and the details that make something feel extraordinary.

From finding the right venue and developing the creative direction to designing the environment, coordinating suppliers and managing production, we connect the moving parts so everything feels like one complete experience.

We don't believe in doing things just because they've always been done that way. We find the right way to make every event unmistakably its own.

sections.headline: A thought. A world. A feeling.
sections.body: Every unforgettable experience has a story behind it. Here's how we turn the thinking into something you can actually step into.

items.title: First, the possibility.
items.description: Before the floor plans, the lighting rigs or the guest lists, there has to be an idea worth bringing to life. We explore the brief, challenge the obvious and find the creative direction that gives the entire experience its purpose and personality.

items.title: Then, the world.
items.description: This is where ideas become spaces. We bring layouts, 3D renders, staging, sound, lighting, branding and environmental design together to create a world that looks, feels and functions as one.

items.title: Finally, the feeling.
items.description: The doors open. The lights change. The room comes alive. Behind the scenes, we coordinate the cues, teams and details that keep everything moving. Out front, people get to enjoy the experience without seeing the work that made it happen.

sections.headline: Pretty is easy.
sections.body:
A logo is a starting point. A colour palette is not a personality. And looking good is only half the job.

We get to know what makes a brand tick, who it needs to connect with and what it should stand for. Then we translate that thinking into a visual language with enough character to be recognised and enough flexibility to work in the real world.

From the first sketch to the final print file, we connect strategy, art direction, design and production. A business card, a billboard, a presentation and an entire environment should all feel like they come from the same imagination.

sections.headline: Every frame
sections.body:
Stories deserve more than a good-looking shot.

We bring ideas to life through film, photography, animation, live streaming and technical production. From a story worth telling to the very last cue, we make each detail count.

sections.headline: The magic has
sections.body:
The final result might last thirty seconds, fill a screen or transform an entire room. What makes it memorable happens long before anyone presses record.

We bring together creative thinking, production planning and technical know-how to make every frame, sound and detail count. From finding the story and capturing the moment to editing, animating, broadcasting live and preparing the finished work, we connect the people and processes behind the scenes.

Sometimes the brief calls for a polished film. Sometimes it needs cameras, a live audience and a reliable stream reaching people somewhere else entirely. We think through the format, crew, equipment, schedules, platforms and final deliverables before the action starts. Because the best production doesn't draw attention to how complicated it was. It makes everything feel exactly as it should.

sections.body: Three stages. Hundreds of decisions. One finished experience. Explore how we take the story from the first sketch to the final frame, whether it's captured, animated or happening live.

items.title: Make it happen.
items.description: Cameras roll. Lights change. The crew, sound and technical elements work together. We capture the planned moments and the unexpected ones, keeping the creative direction intact whether it's a studio shoot, an event or a live broadcast.

items.title: Finish with purpose.
items.description: We shape the edit, animation, graphics, colour and sound until every piece feels intentional. Then we deliver the right formats, captions, recordings, highlights and cutdowns for the screens and audiences that matter.

sections.headline: Elmboog Organiese Boerdery
sections.body: A connected identity for Elmboog Organiese Boerdery, brought to life through a brand guide, company profile, stationery and presentation design.

sections.headline: Rooted in the land.
sections.body:
Give Elmboog a recognisable visual language across the materials people see, read and hold. The identity needed to connect the farm’s name and organic character with a consistent approach to everyday communication.

The work brings together a circular grape-and-field mark, a practical colour palette, typography and an organic flowing pattern, documented in a brand guide.

sections.headline: One identity. Everyday expression.
sections.body:
Deep green, fresh green, warm gold and cream give the identity a natural, confident character. The grape-and-field mark makes a clear connection to farming, while the flowing pattern adds movement across the supporting materials.

“Pure. Organic. Purposeful.” gives the visual system a simple verbal anchor. Colour, type and layout carry that same character from the company profile to the smallest stationery detail.

caseExperience.secondTitle: This is how we made it happen.
caseExperience.secondBody: From a distinctive mark to a family of connected materials. A closer look at the Elmboog identity and its applications, presented through photographic mockups of the supplied design work.

brief.heading: Rooted in the land.
brief.body:
Give Elmboog a recognisable visual language across the materials people see, read and hold. The identity needed to connect the farm’s name and organic character with a consistent approach to everyday communication.

The work brings together a circular grape-and-field mark, a practical colour palette, typography and an organic flowing pattern, documented in a brand guide.
brief.imageAlt: Illustrative review scene with Elmboog logo, pattern and colour proofs

intention.heading: Pure. Organic. Purposeful.
intention.body:
Deep green, fresh green, warm gold and cream give the identity a natural, confident character. The grape-and-field mark makes a clear connection to farming, while the flowing pattern adds movement across the supporting materials.

“Pure. Organic. Purposeful.” gives the visual system a simple verbal anchor. Colour, type and layout carry that same character from the company profile to the smallest stationery detail.
intention.imageAlt: Option 1 Elmboog business cards and letterhead in a stationery mockup

approach.heading: Built to work together.
approach.body:
We carried the identity through the 2025 company profile, business cards, letterhead, email signature and presentation template. Looking at these pieces together keeps the typography, information hierarchy and brand details connected.

The brand guide also explores how the system could extend into posters, workwear, social content and a website. The images shown here are generated presentation mockups based on the supplied artwork; they illustrate the designs and concepts rather than document live installations.

sections.body: A charity padel tournament and cocktail evening built around sport, connection and a purpose beyond the court.

sections.headline: Sport with a bigger purpose.
sections.body:
Amazeballs brought together a padel tournament and an evening of hospitality on 24 October 2026 at Padel 365, Century City. The Amaze-Ball put a R50,000 Golden Point Grand Slam at the centre of a charity event supporting the organisation's mission to give used padel balls a second life.

SHOWSET was responsible for organising the event and bringing its physical and technical requirements together. The venue needed to work as a sporting environment, an evening gathering and a live production space, all on the same night.

seo.title: The Amaze-Ball | Charity Padel Event | SHOWSET
seo.description: How SHOWSET organised The Amaze-Ball for Amazeballs, bringing venue setup, event production, lighting, sound, screens and live broadcasting together in Century City.

projectModules.title: The intention.
projectModules.body:
The idea was to make the experience feel connected from court to crowd. Players needed a place to compete, while guests needed somewhere to gather, follow the action and enjoy the evening.

Amazeballs' distinctive visual identity and the Go for Gold dress theme helped give the occasion its character. The role of the environment, from the event stage to the cocktail tables and screens, was to support those different moments without taking attention away from the cause.

projectModules.title: The approach.
projectModules.body:
SHOWSET coordinated the event setup and prepared the venue with cocktail tables, seating, a stage, lighting, television displays and sound. The audio setup included microphones for the MC and the requirements of the evening programme.

Our production remit also covered the live broadcast, bringing camera coverage and technical delivery into the same event plan. With sport happening on the courts and conversations happening around them, the practical challenge was making all the moving parts work together as one experience.

sections.body:
Build a recognisable home for the Freestyle Legends athlete community. ProVault needed an identity and a platform that could bring profiles, sporting achievements and everyday community activity into one connected experience.

SHOWSET created the project from brand identity and UX/UI to platform development and content, giving the product a consistent voice and visual language.

seo.title: ProVault: brand and digital platform
seo.description: SHOWSET created ProVault for Freestyle Legends, bringing brand identity, UX/UI, platform development and content into one connected athlete community.

projectModules.title: The intention.
projectModules.body:
Put the athlete at the centre. A profile brings together the person, their disciplines, highlights and achievements, helping the community discover more than a name.

The dark interface, gold accents and clear hierarchy give sporting content room to stand out. The experience carries across desktop and mobile so the platform fits into life around the sport.

projectModules.title: The athlete at the centre.
projectModules.alt: Close-up of the ProVault athlete profile held naturally in hand

projectModules.title: The approach.
projectModules.body:
Bring the brand and product together from the start. We developed the identity alongside the interface, translating its visual character into navigation, profiles, community content and achievement cards.

Member discovery, activity, highlights and achievements form a connected platform rather than separate destinations. Responsive layouts adapt the same visual system for desktop and mobile. The imagery shown here presents the live platform in illustrative device mockups.
